description: Na₂CuSbS₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaS₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent SbCuS₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with five equivalent NaS₅ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SbCuS₃ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.79-2.98 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five S atoms to form distorted NaS₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ square pyramids, corners with three equivalent SbCuS₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with five equivalent NaS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SbCuS₃ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.09 Å. Cu is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Sb and three S atoms. The Cu-Sb bond length is 2.76 Å. There are a spread of Cu-S bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.30 Å. Sb is bonded to one Cu and three S atoms to form distorted SbCuS₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₄CuSb octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaS₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-81°. There are a spread of Sb-S bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.50 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Cu, and one Sb atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to five Na and one Sb atom to form SNa₅Sb octahedra that share corners with three SNa₄CuSb octahedra and edges with eight SNa₅Sb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-12°. In the third S site, S is bonded to four Na, one Cu, and one Sb atom to form SNa₄CuSb octahedra that share corners with three SNa₅Sb octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SbCuS₃ trigonal pyramid, and edges with six SNa₅Sb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-9°.
